tag.description:
Comprehensive multi-market DEX trading and on-chain data covering hundreds of DEXs across Ethereum, Solana, BNB Chain, and more.

##### This category includes 16 endpoints:
- [/v4/dex/spot-pairs/latest](/pro-api-reference/token#pairs-listings-latest) - Pairs Listings Latest
- [/v4/dex/pairs/quotes/latest](/pro-api-reference/token#quotes-latest-3) - Quotes Latest
- [/v1/dex/token](/pro-api-reference/token#get-token-detail) - Get Token Detail
- [/v1/dex/token/price](/pro-api-reference/token#get-token-price) - Get Token Price
- [/v1/dex/token/price/batch](/pro-api-reference/token#batch-get-token-prices) - Batch Get Token Prices
- [/v1/dex/tokens/batch-query](/pro-api-reference/token#batch-query-tokens) - Batch Query Tokens
- [/v1/dex/token/pools](/pro-api-reference/token#get-token-pools) - Get Token Pools
- [/v1/dex/token-liquidity/query](/pro-api-reference/token#query-token-liquidity) - Query Token Liquidity
- [/v1/dex/tokens/transactions](/pro-api-reference/token#get-swap-list) - Get Swap List
- [/v1/dex/tokens/trending/list](/pro-api-reference/token#get-trending-tokens) - Get Trending Tokens
- [/v1/dex/new/list](/pro-api-reference/token#get-new-tokens) - Get New Tokens
- [/v1/dex/meme/list](/pro-api-reference/token#get-meme-tokens) - Get Meme Tokens
- [/v1/dex/gainer-loser/list](/pro-api-reference/token#get-top-gainers-and-losers) - Get Top Gainers and Losers
- [/v1/dex/security/detail](/pro-api-reference/token#get-security-detail) - Get Security Detail
- [/v1/dex/search](/pro-api-reference/token#search-tokens) - Search Tokens
- [/v1/dex/liquidity-change/list](/pro-api-reference/token#get-liquidity-change-list) - Get Liquidity Change List

operations.description: Returns a paginated list of all active dex spot pairs with latest market data. Use the "convert" option to return market values in multiple fiat and cryptocurrency conversions in the same call.

parameters.name: network_id
parameters.description: One or more comma-separated CoinMarketCap cryptocurrency network ids.

parameters.name: network_slug
parameters.description: Alternatively, one or more comma-separated network names in URL friendly shorthand slug format (all lowercase, spaces replaced with hyphens). At least one id or slug is required.

parameters.description: One or more comma-separated CoinMarketCap dex exchange ids

parameters.name: dex_slug
parameters.description: Alternatively, one or more comma-separated dex exchange names in URL friendly shorthand slug format (all lowercase, spaces replaced with hyphens). At least one id or slug is required.

parameters.name: base_asset_id
parameters.description: One or more comma-separated CoinMarketCap cryptocurrency ids.

parameters.name: base_asset_symbol
parameters.description: Alternatively, one or more comma-separated network symbol in URL friendly shorthand slug format (all lowercase, spaces replaced with hyphens).At least one id or slug is required.

parameters.description: Alternatively, one base asset contract address in URL friendly shorthand slug format (all lowercase, spaces replaced with hyphens).At least one id or slug is required.

parameters.description: One or more comma-separated CoinMarketCap cryptocurrency ids.

parameters.description: Alternatively, one quote asset contract address in URL friendly shorthand slug format (all lowercase, spaces replaced with hyphens). At least one id or slug is required.

parameters.name: scroll_id
parameters.description: After your initial query, the API responds with the initial set of results and a scroll_ids. To retrieve the next set of results, provide this scroll_id of the last JSON with your follow-up request. scroll_id is an alternative to traditional pagination techniques.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Optionally specify the number of results to return. Use this parameter and the start parameter to determine your own pagination size.

parameters.name: liquidity_min
parameters.description: Optionally specify a threshold of minimum liquidity to filter results by.

parameters.name: liquidity_max
parameters.description: Optionally specify a threshold of maximum liquidity to filter results by.

parameters.name: percent_change_24h_min
parameters.description: Optionally specify a threshold of minimum 24 hour percent change to filter results by.

parameters.name: percent_change_24h_max
parameters.description: Optionally specify a threshold of maximum 24 hour percent change to filter results by.

parameters.description:
Default:`"volume_24h"`

parameters.description:

Optionally specify a comma-separated list of supplemental data fields to return.

parameters.name: reverse_order
parameters.description: Pass true to invert the order of a spot pair. For example, a trading pair is set up as Token B/Token A in the contract and is commonly referred to as Token A/Token B. Using reverse_order would change the order to reflect the true Token B/Token A pairing as it exists in the pool.

parameters.description: Optionally calculate market quotes by CoinMarketCap ID instead of symbol. This option is identical to convert outside of ID format. Ex: convert_id=1,2781 would replace convert=BTC,USD in your query. This parameter cannot be used when convert is used.

operations.description: Returns the latest market quote for 1 or more spot pairs. Use the "convert" option to return market values in multiple fiat and cryptocurrency conversions in the same call.

parameters.name: contract_address
parameters.description: One or more comma-separated contract addresses.

parameters.name: network_id
parameters.description: One or more CoinMarketCap cryptocurrency network ids

parameters.name: network_slug
parameters.description: Alternatively, one network names in URL friendly shorthand "slug" format (all lowercase, spaces replaced with hyphens).

parameters.name: aux
parameters.description:
Default:`""`
Valid values: `"pool_created"` `"percent_pooled_base_asset"` `"num_transactions_24h"` `"pool_base_asset"` `"pool_quote_asset"` `"24h_volume_quote_asset"` `"total_supply_quote_asset"` `"total_supply_base_asset"` `"holders"` `"buy_tax"` `"sell_tax"` `"security_scan"` `"24h_no_of_buys"` `"24h_no_of_sells"` `"24h_buy_volume"` `"24h_sell_volume"`
Optionally specify a comma-separated list of supplemental data fields to return.

parameters.name: convert_id
parameters.description: Optionally calculate market quotes by CoinMarketCap ID instead of symbol. This option is identical to convert outside of ID format. Ex: convert_id=1,2781 would replace convert=BTC,USD in your query. This parameter cannot be used when convert is used.

parameters.name: skip_invalid
parameters.description: Pass true to relax request validation rules. When requesting records on multiple spot pairs an error is returned if no match is found for 1 or more requested spot pairs. If set to true, invalid lookups will be skipped allowing valid spot pairs to still be returned.

parameters.name: reverse_order
parameters.description: Pass true to invert the order of a spot pair. For example, a trading pair is set up as Token B/Token A in the contract and is commonly referred to as Token A/Token B. Using reverse_order would change the order to reflect the true Token B/Token A pairing as it exists in the pool.
